claim_text: A major storm over Washington with every window of the White House lit and glowing, the trees on the grounds stripped bare as after a tornado, and a word that people will be thankful Trump is in office for what is coming.
quote: the lights were all on in every window of the White House
falsify_match: A crisis in which the White House visibly operates through the night and the grounds are storm damaged.
falsify_miss: No such episode. He states the lights are a representation rather than literal, which removes the one detail that could have been checked.

claim_text: Looking northeast he sees a glow on the Niagara river and total absence of light across the border on the Canadian side, which he distinguishes from darkness meaning evil.
quote: I could see a glow on that river for some reason
falsify_match: A blackout or grid failure across the Canadian side of the Niagara border while the American side stays lit.
falsify_miss: No such outage. He explicitly reads the darkness as absence of light rather than as evil, which leaves the referent open.

claim_text: A financial depression comes on Canada because of how the majority voted, and in certain parts it will look as though the tribulation has begun, though he says it has not.
quote: a financial depression coming on Canada
falsify_match: Two or more consecutive years of contraction in Canada with unemployment at depression levels.
falsify_miss: Canadian output and employment stay within ordinary recession bounds or better. Depression is a strong word he does not quantify.

claim_text: A head leader in England turns into a scorpion whose tail stretches out over Europe, pinching its pincers and looking out over the continent.
quote: the scorpion's tail started to stretch out over uh Europe
falsify_match: A British head of state or government leading a coercive move across Europe.
falsify_miss: No such move. The scorpion is his standing image for the British monarchy, so this extends an existing figure rather than adding a test.

claim_text: Apollyon out of the pit puts a demonic countenance on Putin and an escalation of war follows in Europe.
quote: I saw a demonic accountant start coming on his face
falsify_match: A widening of the Russian war into NATO Europe.
falsify_miss: The war stays inside Ukraine. The demonic attribution is not checkable; only the escalation is.

claim_text: He is taken back to the Second World War and sees tanks and military equipment moving through Europe past blown up buildings, as the picture of the escalation coming.
quote: There were blown up buildings in the background
falsify_match: Ground war with armour moving through western or central Europe.
falsify_miss: No armour crosses into NATO Europe. The vision is explicitly of the past, offered as an analogy for what is coming.

claim_text: A line runs into Cuba where a bean sprout with three leaves springs up in the centre, and he is told new financial opportunities will open as a lifeline to Cuba from Russia.
quote: a lifeline to Cuba from Russia in the days ahead
falsify_match: A Russian financial or energy package for Cuba, ideally in three identifiable parts to match the three leaves.
falsify_miss: No new Russian support for Cuba beyond existing arrangements. Base rate: Russia has been extending credit and oil to Cuba since 2022, so the direction was already set.

claim_text: Macron will rise up more in the months ahead and take stands against Israel, and people will wrongly call him the antichrist when he is an Ishmael to the Isaac; also rats in the White House and the Pentagon and a mole up north in Europe.
quote: You'll see Emanuel Mcronone rise up in the days ahead
falsify_match: Macron takes a leading and openly anti-Israel position in the months after August 2025.
falsify_miss: He does not. France announced in July 2025 that it would recognise Palestinian statehood in September, so the position he predicts was already declared.

claim_text: A major revival in Hawaii, a place he says is not on anyone's prayer radar, with a church there asked to plant itself and call it in.
quote: I'm not forgotten Hawaii to have a major revival in Hawaii
falsify_match: A revival in Hawaii large enough to draw people from the other islands and be reported outside the movement.
falsify_miss: No such movement. The condition that a church must first say yes gives an explanation for any absence.

claim_text: He states the rule that the more Democratic or liberal a place is, the greater the revival it will see, given while naming Hawaii, Alaska and Hollywood.
quote: The greater the blue, the greater the revival
falsify_match: Measurable religious growth concentrated in the most Democratic-voting areas.
falsify_miss: Church attendance in those areas keeps declining relative to the rest of the country. The rule is stated as a general principle, so it can be tested against survey data.

claim_text: A major move of God in Hollywood with supernatural visitations on celebrities and revival in the movie theatres.
quote: Hollywood is going to have a revival
falsify_match: A visible wave of public conversions among well-known film industry figures.
falsify_miss: No such wave. Individual celebrity conversions happen regularly, so only a cluster would count.

claim_text: He sees the wife of the Living Word pastors as a young woman travailing in prayer alone, with intercessors catching fire from her like a torch, and says the Lord keeps naming Minnesota.
quote: she was travailing for the lost
falsify_match: A prayer-driven revival at that named church in Minnesota.
falsify_miss: No unusual growth at Living Word. He says he is not familiar with the church, which he offers as evidence the naming did not come from him.

claim_text: He is told Living Word will become a new Azusa Street, and so will Collinsville, Branson, Fort Worth, Eagle Mountain, California and Karis Bible College in Colorado Springs, as multiple strong points like pillars of fire.
quote: There will be multiple Isuza Street revival strong points
falsify_match: Sustained revival meetings drawing outside crowds at several of these named churches at once.
falsify_miss: The named churches carry on at their usual size. The list is specific enough to check, which makes this the strongest form of the revival claim.

claim_text: The porn industry dries up for a season because of what happens in Hollywood, on the pattern of the Welsh revival where the pit ponies had to be retrained.
quote: the porn industry will dry up for a season
falsify_match: A measurable collapse in pornography traffic or revenue attributable to a religious turn.
falsify_miss: Traffic and revenue stay flat or grow. The season framing means any dip of any length could be claimed.

claim_text: Mel Gibson makes a new film on a budget of about fifty million dollars, faces strong opposition over it, and its release sends a shock wave through the movie theatres.
quote: believe for $50 million because the budget will be around $50 million
falsify_match: A Gibson film released with a budget near fifty million that has an outsized cultural effect.
falsify_miss: The budget is far from fifty million or the film lands ordinarily. The Resurrection of the Christ was already announced and in production, with reported budgets well above this figure.

claim_text: The revival is not only American: South America, Australia and every corner of the earth are named, with Holy Ghost fire visiting every nation.
quote: Holy Ghost fire will visit every every corner of the earth
falsify_match: Simultaneous large-scale religious movements across several continents.
falsify_miss: No such simultaneity. Naming every nation removes any place where absence could count against it.

claim_text: A prayer group in Paris, mostly women in their twenties and thirties with a few elders, connected somehow to the Minnesota church, and revival coming in both places.
quote: France, Minnesota. That's what I'm seeing
falsify_match: A named Paris prayer group with a link to Living Word, and revival in both.
falsify_miss: No such group or link is ever identified. He says twice that he does not know what the connection is.

claim_text: A glory cloud, mist and gold dust over the Minnesota church, and a receding of attendance like a wave drawing back before another wave comes.
quote: It looks like there's a drawing back almost like a drying up
falsify_match: Attendance at that church falls and then rises sharply.
falsify_miss: Attendance stays flat. The two-stage shape means a decline confirms the first half and only the second half can fail.

claim_text: Seeds sown in tears by ministers now dead spring up as harvest, in America and in South America, with the glory exceeding what those churches saw in the past.
quote: the seeds you sowed in the past will come to harvest at last
falsify_match: A revival at churches whose founding intercessors have died, exceeding their historic peaks.
falsify_miss: No such reversal. The framing makes any later growth at any old church a fulfilment.

claim_text: A wave of glory hits California even as people leave it, with Hollywood, the pornography industry and pedophilia rings judged and shrivelling.
quote: I see Hollywood being judged. I see the porn industry being judged
falsify_match: Prosecutions collapsing named trafficking networks in California alongside visible religious growth there.
falsify_miss: Neither occurs. Californian out-migration was already in the news, so that half describes the present rather than the future.

claim_text: Coliseums full of young people worshipping, glory events replacing sporting events in the same domes, for a window of opportunity he says will not last forever.
quote: I see coliseums full of young people
falsify_match: Stadium-scale religious gatherings of young people becoming a regular feature.
falsify_miss: No stadium movement emerges. Base rate: stadium revivals already recur in American religious life, so scale would have to be unusual to count.

claim_text: Many Azusa Streets rather than one, named as Minnesota, Living Word, Collinsville, Eagle Mountain and Branson, with people travelling from everywhere to reach them.
quote: it's going to be multiple places and people are going to come from everywhere
falsify_match: Several of the named places running continuous meetings that draw national crowds.
falsify_miss: They do not. This telling names the same churches as the 26 August one, which makes the list stable rather than drifting.

claim_text: Revival expected across Asia, Africa, Europe, the Middle East, Mexico, South America and Australia, with fields full of Indian and Pakistani converts coming in by the millions.
quote: I see fields full of Indians Pakistani India
falsify_match: Conversion numbers in the millions in South Asia within a few years.
falsify_miss: No such numbers. India and Pakistan have both been tightening anti-conversion enforcement, which cuts against it.

claim_text: Heaven and earth collide and everything changes in a 24 hour period, with September and the months ahead named, and revival hot spots seen in Minnesota, Branson, Eagle Mountain and Collinsville.
quote: everything's going to change in a 24-hour period. Watch September
falsify_match: A single day in September in which conditions change irreversibly.
falsify_miss: September passes as an ordinary month. He gives no year here, and the same wording has been applied to more than one September.

claim_text: He is told the temples in India will be shaken down and the false gods broken, by major earthquakes, followed by revival in India and China.
quote: I'm going to shake all the temples in India. I will shake the temples down
falsify_match: Earthquakes in India destroying major temples, followed by mass conversions.
falsify_miss: No such earthquakes. Base rate: India has damaging earthquakes on a decadal cycle, and temples are among the older structures, so some damage in any large quake is near certain.

claim_text: A flood of revival in India and China after the shaking, seen as something never seen before in those areas.
quote: I'm going to visit India. I'm going to visit China
falsify_match: Documented mass conversion movements in both countries.
falsify_miss: No such movement, or continued state suppression preventing any measurement. The second case would leave the claim unresolvable rather than refuted.

claim_text: Teaching from Deuteronomy 28 and Galatians 3:13 that believers are redeemed from the curses and can refuse to participate in the coming storms, hurricanes, New York fires and earthquakes in Alaska and Oregon.
quote: I'm not going to participate in these curses
falsify_match: Not applicable; this is doctrinal teaching about how to face the events, not a new claim.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it recalls the New York fires and the Alaska and Oregon earthquakes as things already given.

claim_text: Teaching that a harvest is limited to thirtyfold, sixtyfold or a hundredfold of what was sown, so believers cannot claim a return larger than their seed, with crypto gains framed as possible grace rather than earned.
quote: every seed produces after its own kind
falsify_match: Not applicable; this is a giving formula rather than a prediction.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it sits directly beside the crypto expectations elsewhere in the corpus.

claim_text: A supervirus built through AI by splicing the genetic code of prescription drugs such as diabetes and heart medicines with a virus, aimed at particular groups, with no vaccine offered in the media this time.
quote: it will be like a supervirus that will be connected to AI technology
falsify_match: An engineered pathogen with a documented link to pharmaceutical genetic material and AI design.
falsify_miss: No such pathogen. The mechanism as described, splicing drug DNA into a virus, does not correspond to how either drugs or viruses work, which makes the specific version unfalsifiable in practice.

claim_text: Asked where the missing children are, he answers that they are being trafficked throughout Europe, which he says he saw in the spirit.
quote: They're all throughout Europe being trafficked
falsify_match: A Europe-wide trafficking network uncovered on the scale he implies.
falsify_miss: No case of that scale emerges. Trafficking prosecutions in Europe are continuous, so only an unprecedented scale would distinguish this from the known baseline.
